fields.description: Avena 2 is a separate four-bedroom villa release within The Valley’s second phase. Emaar presents three façade styles, landscaped shared spaces and a connection to the central park. Its semi-detached layouts combine everyday living and guest accommodation downstairs with bedrooms above and a roof lounge on the second floor.

overview: The wider landscape proposal brings forest and meadow walks, a dunescape, sensory play and river crossings together with community recreation. The shared brochure describes this larger setting rather than a list of facilities inside every villa plot. Buyers should check the route to amenities and their delivery programme for the chosen home.
research.locationNote: The Valley is on the Dubai–Al Ain Road corridor. Avena 2’s setting combines residential streets with access to green space. Check actual driving times and the selected home’s access route when assessing daily convenience.
research.priceNote: The official Avena 2 page and its fact sheet indicate AED 4.37m. This is a marketing starting figure; an available home’s quotation may differ by plot, layout and transaction date.
research.paymentNote: The dedicated Avena 2 sheet sets out 10% on booking, seven 10% instalments and 20% on completion. Some dates differ from the fact sheet and one-page overview. The schedule below follows the dedicated document and requires contract-specific confirmation.
research.handoverNote: The dedicated payment sheet and Property Finder indicate July 2028. The fact sheet instead shows June 2028. July is presented as a provisional estimate, not a resolved contractual promise.

facts.label: Launch scale
facts.value: The Emaar-branded fact sheet lists 332 homes. This project total does not establish current availability.

facts.label: Land and building sizes
facts.value: Launch plots span 2,951–5,247 sq ft. The fact sheet’s 3,708 sq ft built-up reference is rounded; named plans give separate totals.

facts.label: Layout details
facts.value: Plans show two-car parking, a guest bedroom, three upstairs bedrooms, storage and a linen room. A roof lounge and terrace occupy the second floor.
